_comment: TARGET example - a complete, schema-conformant quality result. Unlike benchmark_result.target.json, the SCORES here are real: 85% simple / 65% irrelevance / 75% overall on n=40, the first working BFCL scorecard this lab produced (2026-09-04, 1.5b-q4-llamacpp-orin, docs/TODO.md Phase 1). The surrounding metadata is reconstructed to show the target shape, and n=40 of 638 is a sample - not the final scorecard docs/TODO.md Phase 5 will run.
notes: temperature pinned to 0.1: at llama.cpp's server default (~0.8) this model narrates in prose instead of calling the tool a fraction of the time (12/15 on a repeated identical call), which is a formatting failure rather than a judgment failure - see docs/TODO.md Phase 1. preprocessing_version v2-typefix is the loader after BFCL's non-standard type names (float/tuple/any) were rewritten; results from before that fix are not comparable, because llama.cpp's grammar builder returned HTTP 500 on them.
